Attended surgery and saw a different receptionist who was also excellent.

Doctor was very helpful, professional and caring.

Have previously seen nurses who have also been excellent.

Very happy with this practice which I have been with for many years.

For some reason Google treated this review as false when in fact, as a long standing patient of this excellent practice I wanted to express my thanks.

I only found out that it had not been published when I came to put another review up today which was equally complimentary because I again received absolutely first class and excellent service from this practice.

It is disappointing that Google blocks a positive review without good reason.

I reaffirm the excellent care snd service enjoyed again
